points.description: Role of the learning rate: it controls the speed of convergence of steepest descent (step size). A low learning rate gives slow, smooth convergence; a high learning rate gives faster convergence, but the path may be oscillatory/zigzag (underdamped). Equivalent wording accepted.
Danger: if the learning rate exceeds a critical (maximum) value, the learning becomes unstable (diverges rather than converges). Equivalent wording accepted.
